units.text: 6. A citizen wishing to participate in the competition submits to the local self-government body:

units.text: 2) the questionnaire provided for by Article 15.2 of the Federal Law “On Municipal Service in the Russian Federation”, with a photograph attached;
units.label: Appendix 6 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “2) the questionnaire provided for by Article 15.2 of the…”

units.text: 3) a copy of the passport (the passport is presented in person on arrival for the competition);
units.label: Appendix 6 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “3) a copy of the passport (the passport is presented in person…”

units.text: 4) a copy of the employment record book and/or information on employment history prepared in the procedure established by labour legislation, or other documents confirming the citizen’s employment (service) activity, except where no such activity has previously been performed;

units.text: 6) a certificate from the educational institution confirming that the citizen is obtaining secondary vocational or higher education for the first time through full-time study at that institution funded from budgets of the budgetary system of the Russian Federation. It must also contain information on the educational programme being undertaken (specifying the occupation, speciality or field of study) and the results of interim assessments under the curriculum. The citizen may submit other documents not specified in this Point characterising their personal and business qualities.
units.label: Appendix 6 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “6) a certificate from the educational institution confirming…”

units.locator: Appendix 6 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: 7. The competition commission assesses applicants for targeted education agreements on the basis of the documents specified in Point 6 of these Regulations and the competition procedures’ results. By decision of the local self-government body, those procedures may include individual interviews, questionnaires, testing, preparation of an essay and other procedures not contrary to federal laws or other normative legal acts. The representative body of local self-government determines the methodology for the competition procedures, including applicant assessment criteria.
units.label: Appendix 6 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 · “7. The competition commission assesses applicants for targeted…”

units.locator: Appendix 6 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
units.text: 8. Citizens who participated in the competition are informed of its results in writing no later than 10 days after its completion.

units.text: 9. A targeted education agreement between the local self-government body and a competitively selected citizen is concluded in writing no later than 45 days after the decision on the competition results is adopted.
